categories.main_business_segments: Li Ning Company Limited primarily operates in the professional and leisure sportswear sector, focusing on footwear, apparel, equipment, and accessories under the LI-NING brand. The company also manages other sports product brands such as Double Happiness (table tennis), AIGLE (outdoor sports), and Kason (badminton) through joint ventures and associates. Its business strategy emphasizes a single brand with multiple categories and diversified sales channels, focusing on six core sports categories: running, basketball, fitness, badminton, table tennis, and sports casual.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company invests heavily in technological innovation, developing proprietary technologies such as Carbon Core, Dual-Stage Assist Curves, Super Jiang, GCU, Super BOOM, and Extreme Boom Fiber. These technologies enhance midsoles, outsoles, uppers, and structural components of sports products. Manufacturing incorporates advanced methods like supercritical foaming processes, metal 3D printing, and eco-friendly materials, emphasizing lightweight, durability, and environmental sustainability. The company also integrates smart technologies and sustainable practices in production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Li Ning serves professional athletes and general consumers interested in sports and leisure activities. Its products cater to sports enthusiasts across running, basketball, fitness, badminton, table tennis, and sports casual segments. The company targets both professional sports markets and mass consumer markets, including emerging sports like outdoor activities, golf, tennis, and e-sports. It also focuses on younger generations and female consumers, expanding its reach through diversified channels including e-commerce, retail stores, and franchised distributors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's principal market is Mainland China, including Hong Kong and Macau, which accounts for the vast majority of its revenue. It has a strong retail and distribution network across northern and southern regions of China. Overseas sales contribute less than 10% of total revenue. The company is gradually expanding its international presence, including establishing subsidiaries and joint ventures in Hong Kong, Singapore, South Korea, and Macau.
categories.supply_chain_position: Li Ning operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the sports goods supply chain. It has comprehensive capabilities in research and development, design, manufacturing, marketing, distribution, and retail management. The Group manages an extensive supply chain ecosystem, including supplier management, production facilities, and logistics centers, focusing on flexible supply chain strategies and sustainable practices to optimize inventory and production efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on strengthening its single brand with multi-category offerings and diversified channels. It prioritizes R&D and sports science to drive product innovation, particularly in core sports categories. Li Ning emphasizes technological breakthroughs such as supercritical foaming materials and smart manufacturing technologies. It also invests in sustainable product development, green supply chain management, and expanding into emerging sports markets and international expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Li Ning generates revenue primarily through the sale of sports footwear, apparel, equipment, and accessories. Sales channels include franchised distributors, direct-operated retail stores, and e-commerce platforms. The company also earns income from licensing and brand partnerships. Revenue is derived mainly from product sales in the Chinese market, with a growing contribution from online sales and diversified retail formats.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Li Ning is positioned as one of the leading sports brands in China, competing with both domestic and international sportswear companies. It emphasizes a professional sports brand image combined with stylish and culturally resonant products. The company leverages its technological innovation and Olympic partnerships to strengthen its market position. While specific competitors are not named, Li Ning’s focus on innovation, brand building, and diversified channels supports its competitive stance in a highly competitive sports goods market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, Li Ning reported revenue of approximately RMB28.68 billion, representing a 3.9% increase from 2023. Operating profit was RMB3.68 billion with a gross profit margin of 49.4%. The company maintains a strong financial position with net operating cash inflow of RMB5.27 billion and a debt-to-equity ratio of 36.8%. It has demonstrated steady growth over the past five years, with consistent investments in R&D and brand development, and a dividend payout ratio of 50% for 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Li Ning’s value proposition centers on delivering 'LI-NING’s Experience Value' by combining professional sports performance with stylish design and Chinese cultural elements. The company differentiates itself through proprietary technologies like BOOM and Super BOOM, sustainable and eco-friendly materials, and a strong association with Chinese sports teams and the Olympic Committee. It offers consumers high-quality, innovative, and culturally resonant sports products that enhance athletic performance and lifestyle appeal.
